original_test_intent: Verify the WATCHDOG2 management sensor name, description, reading or discrete state across IB SDR/Sensor List, OOB SDR/Sensor List and BMC Web against its approved watchdog definition without changing timer state.
original_method: Bind the exact WATCHDOG2 record to its watchdog function and SUT/BMC; retain complete aligned IB/OOB lists and Web row; compare record type, raw state, decoded state, description and any units/threshold fields while preserving watchdog, reset and SEL context.
manual_activity: The owner defines WATCHDOG2 record type, function and acceptable states and resolves criteria 3–68; an operator reviews the Web state and reset context, then the owner decides the verdict.
required_inputs: WATCHDOG2 SDR record ID/type and watchdog-function mapping
Expected discrete or analog state, raw decoding, description, units and thresholds if applicable
IB/OOB/Web field mapping and freshness tolerance
Protected access and complete BMC Web capture
Existing watchdog/reset/SEL context and criteria 3–68 decision
safety_requirements: Use read-only queries and protected credentials
Do not arm, pet, expire, reset, clear, configure or inject a watchdog event
Do not clear watchdog, reset, host, BMC or SEL evidence
Retain complete SDR and Sensor lists rather than head-limited output
Stop on active/expired/reset state, unknown record type, identity mismatch or channel disagreement
agent_execution_scope: Verify the unique source and exact WATCHDOG2 record
Collect complete read-only IB/OOB lists and Web evidence
Normalize raw and decoded watchdog fields using owner rules
Report missing, stale, unsupported or inconsistent state without altering it
Perform no watchdog action, criteria invention or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve WATCHDOG2 function, record type and expected state model
Resolve criteria-number gap and whether sensor-get is a sufficient supplemental view
Review IB/OOB/Web and reset context and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The exact target improves relevance, but `sensor get` can be unsupported or incomplete for a discrete watchdog record and the truncated fallback omits required lists and Web parity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely retain full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, exact-match WATCHDOG2 by record identity, capture its Web row, decode its raw/discrete state with the approved map and preserve reset/SEL context.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: WATCHDOG2, both IB/OOB lists, Web, SPEC comparison, Config-Check and 3/0-minute values remain; unsafe log clearing is explicitly disabled.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Compare the same WATCHDOG2 record and decoded state across three surfaces with aligned timestamps and preserved reset evidence.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds record-type-aware decoding and prohibits state-changing watchdog operations.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful sensor-get cannot prove full list presence, Web parity or whether a discrete bit means armed, expired or reset.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Cached Web state and different decoding layers can disagree; raw bytes, record identity and timing are needed.

project_override_considerations: If sensor-get is unsupported for WATCHDOG2, complete SDR/Sensor-list and approved API/Web evidence may be used only through an owner-approved equivalent mapping; no watchdog stimulus is implied.
expected_evidence: WATCHDOG2 specification, record ID/type and watchdog-function map
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists with timestamps/exits
Exact raw and decoded WATCHDOG2 states and complete Web row
Host/BMC/watchdog/reset/SEL context, no-state-change/no-clear audit, criteria decision and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Criteria jump from 2 to 69, the source does not define whether WATCHDOG2 is discrete or analog or what its states mean, and it instructs log clearing that can erase watchdog/reset evidence. DeepSeek truncates required evidence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Passive collection is feasible; the specification, decoding and source clarification are supplyable owner inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2031 Wistron-BMC-01050-V002: define WATCHDOG2 record type, watchdog-function mapping, raw/decoded acceptable states and whether `sensor get` is valid for this record; confirm whether Criteria 1, 2, 69 is only misnumbered or Criteria 3–68 are missing, and approve preserving rather than clearing watchdog/reset/SEL evidence.

review_improvement: Makes the watchdog record semantics explicit, preserves diagnostic evidence and rejects truncated output without introducing any timer stimulus.
independent_technical_reasoning: A watchdog record commonly represents discrete timer status or an event rather than a ranged analog measurement. Reading it is safe only if the command is passive, but interpreting it requires record-type and bit-state definitions. Clearing logs before the check would destroy exactly the reset or expiry context needed to assess an abnormal state, so preservation is mandatory.
